rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.5, fd_recon_eta=0.2, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-7 ETA lower still, breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: eta sweep at t=0.5 MONOTONIC DOWN: eta2.0 rmse0.03027, eta1.0 rmse0.01360, eta0.5 rmse0.01175 (BEST, ssim0.904). Less DPS = better because DPS-without-hard-CG over-corrects. (2) Failure mode: any nonzero DPS soft-gradient perturbs the FBP warm-start off-manifold; the prior alone denoising the FBP is the strongest DC-off mode. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 0.5->0.2 at t=0.5, steps=8. (4) HYPOTHESIS: eta=0.2 rmse below 0.01175, approaching the pure-prior-denoise limit (eta->0). Tests whether even the optimal DC-off recon (prior-denoised FBP, minimal DPS) clears the calibrated FBP baseline. (5) BUDGET: <5min. (6) Loop continues.
